meal_plans.name: Bermuda Plan
meal_plans.description: The Bermuda meal plan offers three meals at select restaurants, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner along with drinks included. Ideal for a hassle-free, all-inclusive dining experience.

meal_plans.name: Dinner Plan
meal_plans.description: The Dinner Plan provides guests with two meals included in their stay: breakfast and dinner.

meal_plans.name: American Plan
meal_plans.description: It includes all three major meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the length of your stay. Generally, the rates on this plan are higher but offer a good value for your money, and of course, added convenience.

meal_plans.name: Modified American Plan
meal_plans.description: Also known as Half Board or Half Pension meal plan. It is a modified version of the American Plan and includes a room stay with breakfast and a choice between lunch and dinner.

meal_plans.name: Continental Plan
meal_plans.description: It is where your room stay involves a daily breakfast at the hotel. The hotel can either affix its option of breakfast menu or provide in the dining area for a buffet breakfast. Also, whether the room service provides the breakfast or in a general dining area, depends from hotel to hotel.

meal_plans.name: European Plan
meal_plans.description: Only the stay is included in the rates and that you will have to pay extra for using the hotel’s dining facilities. This can be called the “Room Only” Plan.

days.title: Arrival in Almaty
days.desc: Salem! Upon arrival at the Almaty International Airport, you will be transferred to your pre-booked hotel. Post check-in, you can relax at the hotel or head out to explore the city at your own pace. Visit the Zelyony Bazaar, Abai Square and more such places to explore the local culture, cuisine and crafts. Later, you will return to your hotel on your own for an overnight stay.

days.title: Almaty City Tour
days.desc: In the morning, get ready to go on Almaty city tour. You will be driven to Panfilov Park, a beautiful park with lush landscapes and visit the iconic Zenkov Cathedral, admiring its unique wood architecture. In the afternoon, you will be transferred to the Republic Square, enjoying the view of the Independence Monument and a beautiful sunset in the backdrop. After the city tour, you will be driven back to your hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Day Trip to Medeu Ice Skating Rink and Shymbulak Ski Resort
days.desc: Start your day by getting transferred to Medeu, and feel the adrenaline rush of skating at one of the largest alpine rinks in the world. Further, you will ascend the Shymbulak Ski Resort through a scenic cable car ride. Located at about 2,200 meters above sea level, the view from Shymbulak includes snow-capped peaks and lush valleys. Later, you will be transferred back to the hotel for an overnight stay.

items.title: Day Trip to Medeu Ice Skating Rink & Shymbulak Ski Resort

days.title: Day Trip to Green Bazaar & Rahat Chocolate Factory | Visit to Kok Tobe Park
days.desc: You will board your transfer to the iconic Green Bazaar, where you can shop for souvenirs, clothes & local snacks to take back home with you. Next, you will be visiting the Rahat Chocolate Factory, where you'll learn about the process of chocolate making and get to take some of the sweets with you. Next, enjoy a cable car ride to Kok Tobe Park, to enjoy various amusement rides & panoramic views of the surrounding landscape. Afterwards, you will be driven back to your hotel for an overnight stay.

items.title: Trip to Green Bazaar & Rakhat Chocolate Factory, Almaty

days.title: Day Trip to Issyk Lake
days.desc: Admire the beauty of Issky Lake, as you go on a wonderful day trip. As you reach the lake, enjoy a leisurely walk around the shores as you take-in the views of the surroundings. Also, visit the State Historical and Cultural Museum-Reserve and learn about the area's past and history. After exploring the place, get transferred back to the hotel for an overnight stay.

items.title: Issyk Lake Day Tour From Almaty on a Private basis
Issyk State Historical and Cultural Reserve-Museum

days.title: Transfer to Baku
days.desc:
Welcome to Azerbaijan! Upon your arrival at the airport in Baku, you will get transferred to your hotel. After check-in, spend the rest of the day at your own pace. You can either explore nearby places or visit 
Baku Eye, Teze Pir Mosque, Dənizkənarı Milli Park, and other such attractions. Afterwards, head back to your hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Baku Old City Tour | Gobustan National Park & Mud Volcanoes Tour
days.desc: In the morning, step back in time as you go on the old city tour of Baku. Explore the amazing streets of Baku's Old City, also known as Icherisheher. Admire the architectural wonders of the Palace of the Shirvanshahs, and ascend the ancient Maiden Tower for breathtaking views of the city skyline. Further, visit Gobustan National Park & Mud Volcanoes, and engage yourself in history as you see Petroglyphs at the museum. Afterwards, get transferred back to your hotel for an overnight stay.

items.title: Baku Old City Tour on a Private basis
Gobustan National Park & Mud Volcanoes Tour from Baku on a Private basis

days.title: Transfer to Gabala | Day Trip to Gabala and Tufandag Mountain
days.desc: Check-out from the hotel in Baku and go on a scenic journey to Gabala. Upon arrival at the hotel in Gabala, check-in, and rest for a while before going for a day trip to Gabala and Tufandag Mountain.  Take a cable car ride to enjoy panoramic views of the surrounding peaks and valleys. Participate in optional activities such as hiking, horseback riding, or zip-lining. After the tour, get transferred back to your hotel for an overnight stay.

items.title: Check-in at Qabala Yeddi Gozel Hotel
Day Trip to Gabala and Tufandag Mountain from Baku on a Private basis

days.title: Sheki City Sightseeing Tour
days.desc: In the morning, get ready to go on the Sheki sightseeing tour. Visit the Sheki Khan Palace, a fusion of Persian and Azerbaijani architecture, explore Sheki Karvansaray's stone walls and vibrant marketplace, showcasing the past trading system, and indulge in Sheki Pakhlava and traditional Piti, trying flavours that define Azerbaijani culture. Later, get transferred back to your hotel for an overnight stay.

items.title: Sheki City Sightseeing Tour on a Private basis

days.title: Transfer to Baku | Absheron Peninsula Tour
days.desc: Check-out from the hotel in Gabala and journey back to Baku, with a scenic drive through the landscapes of the Absheron Peninsula. Upon reaching the hotel in Baku, check-in & rest for a while before going out for the Absheron Peninsula Tour. Witness the Ateshgah Fire Temple, a religious complex dedicated to Zoroastrianism, & Yanar Dag, the Burning Mountain, where natural gas vents ignite continuously, creating a mesmerizing flame. After the tour, transfer back to the hotel for an overnight stay.

items.title: Absheron Peninsula Tour from Baku on a Private basis

days.title: Departure Day
days.desc: Check-out from the hotel, and get transferred to Heydar Aliyev International Airport for your onward journey. Depart Azerbaijan with cherished memories of your unforgettable adventures.
